Airport Transfers

The flight is yours.
The drive is ours.

ATL arrivals and departures, thoughtfully arranged around your travel plans.

FLIGHT MONITORING / ARRIVAL COORDINATION

An airport transfer is more than the distance between a terminal and an address. It starts with the flight details, the size of your party and the luggage coming with you. Martinez Logistics brings flight monitoring, luggage assistance and coordinated pickup arrangements to ATL arrivals and departures.

For arrivals, provide the airline, flight number and destination, then confirm the meeting instructions with the company. For departures, include the exact pickup address and flight time so the collection can be planned around check-in and the day’s journey. Meet-and-greet requirements should be arranged in advance.

01

On arrival

Share the actual arriving flight, even when the reservation is being made by a host. Keep your contact number available for pickup updates, and confirm the meeting location before leaving the terminal.

02

Before departure

Use the airline’s recommended arrival window when discussing your pickup. Include any intermediate stop, gate access and the number of bags so the vehicle and timing fit the whole journey.

03

For your party

Choose Sedan, SUV or Sprinter by the needs of the complete group. Confirm seating, luggage capacity, child-seat requests and accessibility requirements before reserving.

BEFORE YOU TRAVEL

Useful details.

Where will I meet my chauffeur at ATL?

Confirm your meeting instructions directly with the company for your terminal and selected service. Follow the agreed pickup plan and the airport’s current vehicle access rules; meet-and-greet requests should be arranged in advance.

Is an arrival booking different from a departure?

Yes. The live booking menu has separate ATL arrival and departure listings for each vehicle category. Choose the correct direction before selecting an appointment.

Can my transfer include another stop?

Tell the company about every stop before booking. The route, extra time and any additional charges need to be agreed rather than assumed to be included in a transfer listing.
